title: Rewoconnect
shortDescription: A builders marketplace for managing the entire workflow.
fullDescription: A comprehensive marketplace for builders, enabling buyers and subcontractors to manage their workflow efficiently. Features include profile creation, job postings, inventory management, and invoice handling to streamline the entire construction process.

title: Dynamic Artist Portfolio
shortDescription: A dynamic portfolio for artists with a Supabase dashboard.
fullDescription: A fully dynamic portfolio built for a artist, powered by Supabase for seamless content management. The client can control and update their entire portfolio through a dedicated dashboard, showcasing their work with ease.

title: Veeble
shortDescription: A modern UI revamp for better performance and UX.
fullDescription: A complete UI/UX overhaul for Veeble's website. The project focused on modernizing the design, improving Core Web Vitals, and enhancing interactivity to deliver a superior user experience.

title: Codex
shortDescription: A lightweight code snippet management platform.
fullDescription: Codex is a lightweight and efficient code snippet management platform for developers. It offers features like tag-based organization, advanced search, live previews for web snippets, and secure offline storage using IndexedDB.

title: Form Builder
shortDescription: An interactive form builder with a drag-and-drop interface.
fullDescription: An interactive form builder with a drag-and-drop interface, built using KendoReact components. It allows users to create custom forms, customize components, see live previews, and export forms as JSON or JSX. An integrated AI chat assistant enables form creation through natural language commands.

title: Movie Clone App
shortDescription: A movie listing app using the TMDB API.
fullDescription: A sleek and interactive movie listing web application that leverages the TMDB API to display a vast collection of movies. Users can browse, search, and discover new films through a modern and engaging interface.

title: Wall of Love
fullDescription: An intelligent testimonial collection system that automates the feedback loop. It uses Postmark for inbound email processing to receive testimonials, leverages AI for analysis and sentiment scoring, and displays curated feedback beautifully on the website.
